title: Game stat updated
description: A player's value for a game stat changed. The subject is the stat definition.

game_id.description: The game the stat belongs to.

stat_key.description: Stable per-game identifier for the stat.

trust.description: The trust level the write was accepted at. player means the player's own token wrote it; game means a game-authoritative write did.

value.description: The player's value after this update.

updated_at.description: When the value changed, in the service's clock.
